decisions.reason: Datil changes the production network used for Lit gating, while the source explicitly says the user-facing reader behavior remains unchanged.
The Lit production-network selection does not change IPFS storage, Pinata, or the required ebook take-down option.
Configuring Lit production gating on Datil does not alter how book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets follow an NFT after transfer.
The source establishes an internal Lit network configuration and does not request any FAQ copy change.
The Datil configuration does not change the About-page content or resolve its existing prize-payout-copy ambiguity.
Lit production gating is independent of Brevo delivery, winner notifications, and mint-confirmation email contents.
The Lit network choice does not change no-referral commission triggers, amounts, or recipient selection.
The production network used for gated PDF access does not affect landing-page book-cover placement, dimensions, or cropping.
The Datil configuration does not require any change to landing-page copy, layout, prize marketing, or responsive behavior.
Lit-based book gating is independent of the deferred Transak fiat-mint flow and its wallet-provisioning behavior.
Datil is the Lit Protocol production network, not a replacement for the Base blockchain on which the NFT remains deployed and whose ERC-721 ownership Lit verifies.
The Lit production-network selection does not change email magic-link authentication or fiat-buyer dashboard access.
